# Angel One Trading & Data Instruction System Plan

## Goal Description
Build a complete algorithmic trading and market data analysis system powered by **Angel One SmartAPI**. The system will:
1. Authenticate with Angel One using API Key, Client Code, MPIN, and TOTP.
2. Fetch live market data, LTP, and historical OHLC candle data for Indian indices (Nifty, Bank Nifty) and stocks.
3. Compute technical indicators (EMA crossover, RSI, Supertrend) to generate clear trade instructions (BUY/SELL, Entry, Stop Loss, Target).
4. Provide both **Paper Trading** (simulation) and **Live Order Placement** execution modes.
5. Provide a mobile-responsive **Web Dashboard** (viewable directly on mobile/browser via the project preview) to monitor live status, signals, and trade history.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Angel One SmartAPI"] -->|Auth & Session| B["Angel Connector (angel_client.py)"]
    B -->|LTP & Candles| C["Market Data Engine"]
    C -->|Price Data| D["Strategy & Signal Engine (strategy_engine.py)"]
    D -->|Trade Signals (Buy/Sell/SL/Target)| E["Order Manager (order_manager.py)"]
    E -->|Mode: Paper Trading| F["Simulation / Trade Logs"]
    E -->|Mode: Live Trading| G["Angel One Order Execution"]
    B & D & E -->|API / State| H["Web Dashboard (Mobile Friendly UI)"]
```

---

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **API Credentials Needed for Live Operation:**
> To connect to Angel One, you will need your credentials from the [Angel One SmartAPI Portal](https://smartapi.angelbroking.com):
> - `API Key`
> - `Client Code` (Angel One User ID)
> - `MPIN / Password`
> - `TOTP Secret Key` (from Angel One 2FA setup, enabling automated OTP generation via PyOTP)
>
> *Note: We will provide dummy/simulation mode out of the box so you can test everything immediately without exposing credentials.*

> [!WARNING]
> **Default Execution Mode will be Paper Trading (Simulation):**
> To protect capital and verify accuracy, trade instructions will default to Paper Trading (Signals & Logs only). Live order execution will require explicit toggling in the configuration.

## Proposed Changes

### Core Python Backend

#### [NEW] `config.py`
- Configuration loader for API keys, symbol tokens, risk parameters, and paper-trading toggle.
- Safe fallback to environment variables or simulated mode.

#### [NEW] `angel_client.py`
- Wrapper for Angel One `SmartConnect`.
- Automatic TOTP generation with `pyotp`.
- Methods for:
  - `login()`: Session generation & token refresh.
  - `get_profile()`: Account information & balance.
  - `get_ltp(exchange, tradingsymbol, symboltoken)`: Fetch latest market price.
  - `get_candle_data(...)`: Fetch historical candles (1m, 5m, 15m, 1d) for technical analysis.
  - `place_order(...)`: Secure order routing.

#### [NEW] `strategy_engine.py`
- Strategy logic implementing technical analysis:
  - 9/21 EMA crossover detection.
  - RSI overbought/oversold filtering.
  - ATR-based Stop Loss & Target calculation.
- Emits structured `TradeInstruction` objects with:
  - Timestamp, Instrument, Action (BUY / SELL), Entry Price, Target, Stop Loss, Risk-to-Reward ratio.

#### [NEW] `order_manager.py`
- Manages active trades, position sizing, and simulation/execution.
- Logs every instruction to `trades.json` for persistence and audit.

#### [NEW] `server.py`
- Lightweight backend API (FastAPI / Flask) exposing endpoints:
  - `GET /api/status`: System & connection health.
  - `GET /api/market-data`: Live prices & recent candles.
  - `GET /api/signals`: Latest trade instructions.
  - `POST /api/test-login`: Quick credential test.

---

### Frontend Web Dashboard (Mobile-Ready)

#### [NEW] `index.html`
- Responsive dashboard layout optimized for phone screens and desktop.
- Live market ticker cards (NIFTY 50, BANK NIFTY).
- Real-time trade instructions feed with badge status (BUY / SELL / TARGET REACHED / STOPPED OUT).
- Credentials test & setup modal.

#### [NEW] `style.css`
- Modern dark-theme trading terminal styling (high-contrast green/red signals, sleek typography, card widgets).

#### [NEW] `app.js`
- Polling & state management to fetch latest market data and trade instructions from backend or live simulation.

## Verification Plan

### Automated Tests
- Test Angel One SmartAPI import and session handler:
  ```bash
  python3 -m unittest discover tests/
  ```
- Test strategy engine signal generation with mock candle datasets.
- Test TOTP generation and parameter formatting.

### Manual Verification
1. **Connection Test:** Run connection script with test/live credentials to confirm successful handshake with Angel One servers.
2. **Data Fetch Test:** Fetch live LTP and 5-minute candle data for NIFTY / BANKNIFTY.
3. **Signal Generation Test:** Trigger strategy on historical candle series and verify BUY/SELL instruction outputs with Stop Loss and Target.
4. **Mobile Dashboard Test:** Open preview link `https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/83525965-a1ae-4476-9410-1f0f69bfe85c/7c74a98333164ab498ef335c/` to verify responsive display on iOS.
